segment_contamination_dimensions: Telecom-specialist buyer segment (BTS/tower operators procuring sealed insulated telecom enclosures) — carved out by sibling MCAT 'Telecom Shelters' (42756); names and alt names that exclusively target telecom BTS enclosure buyers are discarded. 'BTS shelter' retained only as a trade name since it also appears in general portable shelter listings, but 'telecom shelter' itself is discarded as it matches the sibling MCAT name.

Military/defence procurement buyer segment — carved out by sibling MCAT 'Military Shelters' (33228); names exclusively targeting defence/military buyers (e.g., 'army field shelter', 'military portable shelter') are discarded. The buyer intent query 'portable shelter 10x23 army military' is retained in sanitised form ('portable shelter 10x23 for site use') to avoid direct military-segment targeting.

Dome-structure specialist buyer segment — carved out by sibling MCAT 'Dome Shelters' (26766); names exclusively referencing dome prefab shelters are discarded from enhanced names and primary keywords.

Industrial shed (permanent/semi-permanent large-span) buyer segment — carved out by siblings 'Industrial Sheds' (30719), 'Industrial Shelters' (30721), 'Prefabricated Factory Shed' (136750), and 'Warehouse Sheds' (164769); names implying permanent large-span factory or warehouse structures are discarded.

Garage/vehicle storage specialist buyer segment — carved out by siblings 'Portable Garage' (35070) and 'Folding Garage' (107235); names using 'garage' are discarded. 'Foldable portable shelter for vehicle parking' is retained as it describes a shelter use case, not a garage product.
